title: SWF DefineSprite: compile symbols as MovieClips
description: Extend the SWF compiler (packages/swf) to emit DefineSpriteTag (tag 39) for Symbol library items with their timelines, so MovieClip symbols are properly compiled rather than skipped. SymbolInstance display objects should emit PlaceObject2 pointing to the sprite character. Covers multi-frame symbols and nested instances. See docs/14-publishing-export.md and docs/15-file-formats-fla-swf.md.
